# Keydler

> Free, local-first supervised task memory for you and your AI.

Keydler keeps decisions, rules, evidence and failed approaches on a web page so the next conversation continues from the right place.

## Product

- MIT-licensed local workspace in the browser. No account required.
- WebMCP tools so compatible agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) read and update the same log.
- Humans supervise writes: stale writes are refused, retries do not duplicate, the audit stays readable.

## Source

https://github.com/kymrapro-del/ChatGPT-WebMCP
